q: 这个 Web Crawler 题的核心目标最准确地说是什么？
options: 从种子 URL 出发抓取网页、抽取文本并保存给后续训练使用
实时渲染所有 JavaScript 页面并抓取图片视频
为网站管理员提供可视化爬虫管理后台
构建一个能搜索和排序网页的完整搜索引擎
why: 目标收敛到为 LLM 训练收集网页文本，而不是做搜索排名、动态渲染或非文本处理。面试重点是抓取、抽取、存储和扩展。
why_en: The design is scoped to crawl from seed URLs, extract page text, and store it for later LLM training rather than building a full search engine.
scenario: 面试官要求设计一个为 LLM 训练收集网页文本的抓取系统（类似 OpenAI/Google 的训练数据管线），而不是搜索引擎或问答产品。
options_en: Crawl from seed URLs, extract page text, and store it for later training.
Render every page's JavaScript live and capture images and video.
Give website admins a dashboard to manage crawler behavior.
Build a full search engine that indexes and ranks web pages.
q_en: What is the core goal of this web crawler design?
scenario_en: The interviewer asks for a crawler that collects web text for LLM training, like an OpenAI or Google training-data pipeline, not a search engine or QA product.

q: Web Crawler 的核心功能需求包括哪些？（多选）
options: 从给定种子 URL 开始遍历网页
抽取每个网页的文本并存储
训练最终的大语言模型
处理登录后才能看到的页面
why: 本题只覆盖抓取和文本落库；训练模型、鉴权页面、动态内容、图片视频都被放到范围外。先明确范围能防止设计发散。
why_en: The core functions are crawling from seed URLs and storing extracted text, while model training and authenticated or dynamic content are out of scope.
options_en: Traverse the web starting from given seed URLs.
Extract each page's text and store it.
Train the final large language model.
Handle pages that require logging in.
q_en: Which functions are core requirements for this web crawler? (Select all that apply)

scenario: 这个爬虫的主线是收集公开静态网页文本，供后续 LLM 训练数据管线使用。
scenario_en: This crawler is scoped to collect public static web text for a later LLM training-data pipeline.
q: 这个 LLM 文本爬虫明确放到范围外的事项有哪些？（多选）
options: 处理非文本数据，如图片和视频
处理 JavaScript 渲染出的动态内容
处理需要登录的页面
记录每个 URL 的抓取状态
why: 非文本、动态内容、认证页面都不在核心设计里；URL 状态记录反而是后续容错和去重需要的内部状态。范围外不代表不能扩展，只是主线不展开。
why_en: Non-text media, JavaScript-rendered content, and authenticated pages are explicitly out of scope, while URL state tracking remains part of the crawler design.
options_en: Handling non-text data such as images and video.
Handling dynamic content rendered by JavaScript.
Handling pages that require a login.
Tracking each URL's crawl status.
q_en: Which items are explicitly out of scope for this LLM text crawler? (Select all that apply)

q: 这个 LLM 文本爬虫的核心非功能需求包括哪些？（多选）
options: 故障后能恢复且不丢进度
遵守 robots.txt 并避免压垮站点
5 天内完成大规模抓取
强一致地更新网页排名
why: 非功能主线是容错、礼貌、效率和可扩展到 10B 页面；网页排名不在这个 LLM 文本抓取题的主目标里。后续深挖都围绕这些约束展开。
why_en: The important nonfunctional requirements are fault tolerance, politeness, five-day completion, and scale to ten billion pages.
scenario: 该系统要为 LLM 训练抓取约 10B 网页文本，业务方要求 5 天内可用，并且不能对被抓取网站造成过大压力。
options_en: Recover from failures without losing progress.
Respect robots.txt and avoid overloading sites.
Finish the large-scale crawl within five days.
Keep page-rank scores strongly consistent.
q_en: Which nonfunctional requirements matter most for this LLM text crawler? (Select all that apply)
scenario_en: The crawler needs to collect about 10 billion web pages for LLM training within five days without overloading the sites it visits.

q: 这组体量假设最直接决定了后续设计的哪个环节？
options: 决定了 Metadata DB 该选关系型还是文档型
决定了需要多少台抓取机器和总带宽预算
决定了要不要给每个域名设置速率限制
决定了文本抽取该用哪种 NLP 模型
why: 10B 页面和 2MB/页是后续带宽和机器数估算的输入锚点，不是要背的孤立数字。
why_en: The page count and average page size are the anchor inputs for bandwidth and fleet-size math, not facts to memorize on their own.
scenario: 面试官给出规模假设：网页总量约 10B，平均每页传输体量约 2MB（HTML 本身更小，但要给内联资源和规划余量）。
options_en: It determines whether the metadata store should be relational or document-based.
It determines how much bandwidth and how many crawler machines you need.
It determines whether to rate-limit each domain.
It determines which NLP model to use for text extraction.
q_en: Which later design decision is most directly driven by these scale assumptions?
scenario_en: The interviewer gives a scale assumption: about 10 billion pages, with roughly 2 MB transferred per page to leave room for embedded resources and planning margin.

q: 补全这个数据处理系统的输入和输出：
text: 输入是{{种子 URL}}；输出是从网页中抽取并保存的{{文本数据}}。
why: 非用户交互系统先定义边界很有用：系统接收什么、产出什么。这里边界非常清楚，后续组件只是在这条数据流上扩展。
why_en: For this data-processing system, the input is seed URLs and the output is extracted text data stored for later use.
q_en: Fill in the input and output of this data-processing system:

q: 把基础 Web Crawler 的数据流排成正确顺序。
steps: 抽取文本并把文本存入对象存储
从 Frontier 取出下一个 URL
解析页面里的新链接并加入待抓取集合
通过 DNS 解析域名到 IP
向外部网页服务器拉取 HTML
why: 先拿 URL，再解析域名并抓取 HTML；拿到页面后才抽取文本和新链接。这个朴素流程后续会被拆成更可靠的流水线。
why_en: The crawler takes a URL, resolves DNS, fetches HTML, extracts and stores text, then enqueues newly discovered links.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A[Frontier URL] --> B[DNS]
  B --> C[Fetch HTML]
  C --> D[Extract text]
  C --> E[Extract links]
  E --> A
  D --> F[S3 text]
q_en: Put the basic web crawler data flow in the correct order.

q: 高层设计里哪些组件属于核心路径？（多选）
options: Frontier Queue
Crawler
DNS
S3 文本存储
广告投放服务
why: Frontier 管待抓 URL，Crawler 拉取和解析，DNS 支持访问外部站点，S3 存文本输出。广告投放与这个离线抓取系统无关。
why_en: The basic path uses a frontier queue, crawler workers, DNS, and blob storage for text output.
options_en: Frontier queue of URLs waiting to be crawled.
The crawler that fetches and parses pages.
DNS resolution for external domains.
S3 storage for extracted text.
An ad-serving service.
q_en: Which components belong on the core high-level path? (Select all that apply)

scenario: 爬虫要保存海量网页文本供后续批处理和训练读取，数据体量巨大，访问模式是对象级读写，不需要关系型事务。
q: 文本数据最适合存到哪里？
options: 存进 Redis 字符串缓存
只留在爬虫本机磁盘
对象存储（S3 / GCS 等 Blob 服务）
直接写进 Frontier 队列消息体
why: 抽取后的文本是大规模 blob 数据，适合便宜、持久、可扩展的对象存储；队列只传引用，不能承载大 payload。数据库或缓存只保元数据更合理。
why_en: Extracted text is large blob data, so object storage is the right durable and scalable target while queues should carry only references.
whenOtherWins: 如果是少量结构化查询字段，放关系型或 NoSQL 表更方便；如果是短期热点小对象，缓存可以作为读取加速层。
tradeoff: 对象存储的持久与低成本 vs 队列/缓存的即时但脆弱访问
options_en: Store it as a Redis string.
Keep it only on the crawler's local disk.
Object storage such as S3 or GCS.
Write it straight into the Frontier queue message.
q_en: Where should the extracted text data be stored?
scenario_en: The crawler must store massive extracted text for later batch processing and training reads; access is object-level and does not need relational transactions.

q: 面试中追问种子 URL 的来源，主要体现了什么设计意识？
options: 它能让 DNS 缓存完全失效
它把文本抽取改成实时查询问题
它证明不需要 Frontier Queue
它明确系统启动边界，避免默认全网可达
why: 几乎所有爬虫都从有限种子集合启动，且不可能覆盖全网。问清楚种子来源是在确认系统输入，而不是假设能自动发现所有页面。
why_en: Clarifying seed URLs defines the system's starting boundary and avoids pretending the crawler can discover the entire web from nothing.
options_en: It makes DNS caching completely ineffective.
It turns text extraction into a real-time query problem.
It proves the Frontier Queue is unnecessary.
It clarifies the system's starting boundary instead of assuming full web reachability.
q_en: What design awareness does asking about seed URL sources show?

scenario: 单个 Crawler 同时负责 DNS、抓 HTML、抽文本、抽链接；任何一步失败都会让整条 URL 处理进度变得不清晰。
q: 提升容错性的首要改造是什么？
options: 拆成 Fetcher 和 Extraction 两个流水线阶段
只加更多线程，不改变任务边界
把原始 HTML 直接放进队列消息体里
把所有步骤塞进一个更大的单体进程
why: 流水线把失败隔离在单个阶段，可以重试抓取或解析而不重做其他工作，也能按瓶颈独立扩缩容。它是数据处理题常见的第一层可靠性改造。
why_en: Splitting the crawler into pipeline stages isolates failures, enables stage-level retries, and lets each stage scale independently.
whenOtherWins: 如果流量极小且失败代价低，一个简单单进程实现足够；但 10B 页面和 5 天期限下，阶段边界更重要。
tradeoff: 阶段隔离便于重试和独立扩容 vs 单体实现更简单
options_en: Split into separate Fetcher and Extraction pipeline stages.
Just add more threads without changing task boundaries.
Put the raw HTML directly inside the queue message.
Cram every step into one larger monolithic process.
q_en: What is the first change to improve fault tolerance?
scenario_en: One crawler process handles DNS, HTML fetch, text extraction, and link extraction; if any step fails, the URL's progress becomes ambiguous.

q: URL Fetcher 和 Text/URL Extraction 的关键职责区别是什么？
options: Fetcher 解析链接，Extraction 访问 DNS
Fetcher 拉取并保存原始 HTML，Extraction 从 HTML 中产出文本和新 URL
Fetcher 更新模型参数，Extraction 训练模型
Fetcher 做去重，Extraction 管队列可见性
why: Fetcher 处理最容易失败的网络抓取并保存原始 HTML；Extraction 处理已经落库的 HTML，输出文本和链接。这个边界让抓取和解析可以分别重试。
why_en: The fetcher retrieves and stores raw HTML, while extraction workers read that HTML to produce text and discovered URLs.
tradeoff: 抓取失败隔离 vs 解析失败隔离——两个阶段各自的重试边界
options_en: The fetcher parses links while extraction talks to DNS.
The fetcher retrieves and stores raw HTML; extraction turns that HTML into text and new URLs.
The fetcher updates model weights while extraction trains the model.
The fetcher deduplicates while extraction manages queue visibility.
q_en: What is the key responsibility split between the URL Fetcher and Text/URL Extraction?

scenario: 队列需要传递待处理 URL，但每个 URL 还要记录抓取状态、HTML 对象地址、文本对象地址、失败次数和深度等元数据。
q: Web Crawler 应该新增什么组件承载这些 URL 状态？
options: 让每个 Worker 用本地文件记录状态
只依赖浏览器缓存
Metadata DB，队列消息只放 URL 记录 id
把完整 HTML 和状态都塞进 SQS 消息
why: Metadata DB 保存可查询、可更新的 URL 状态和对象存储引用；队列负责调度，不适合大 payload 或复杂状态。DynamoDB、Postgres、MySQL 都可讨论。
why_en: A metadata database should hold URL state and blob references while the queue carries only lightweight identifiers for scheduling.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是临时小任务且不需要恢复，消息体可以带完整上下文；这里的规模和容错要求需要持久元数据。
diagram:
flowchart LR
Seeds[Seed URLs] --> Frontier[URL Frontier]
Frontier --> State[(URL state DB)]
Frontier --> Queue[Fetch queue]
Queue --> Fetcher[Fetcher workers]
tradeoff: 持久可查询的元数据存储 vs 把状态硬塞进队列消息
options_en: Have each worker keep state in a local file.
Rely only on the browser cache.
A Metadata DB, with the queue message carrying only the URL record id.
Stuff the full HTML and all state into the SQS message.
q_en: What component should the web crawler add to hold URL state?
scenario_en: The queue needs to pass URLs to process, but each URL also needs metadata such as crawl status, HTML object location, text object location, failure count, and depth.

q: 为什么不应该把原始 HTML 直接放进 Frontier 或处理队列消息里？
options: 这样做会让 DNS 解析明显变慢
这样做会导致 robots.txt 无法被正确解析
队列消息根本不允许携带任何字符串
队列不适合大 payload，应传对象存储引用而非内容本身
why: 队列适合传小消息和调度信号，不适合承载大量 HTML 内容。把 HTML 放对象存储、在消息里传 metadata id 或 URL 引用更稳。
why_en: Queues are optimized for lightweight scheduling messages, not large HTML payloads, so workers should pass blob references instead.
options_en: It would make DNS resolution noticeably slower.
It would prevent robots.txt from being parsed correctly.
A queue cannot store any string at all.
Queues are not built for large payloads; pass an object-storage reference instead.
q_en: Why should raw HTML not be placed directly in the Frontier or processing queue messages?

q: 保存原始 HTML 对后续需求变化有什么直接好处？
options: 可以更换文本抽取逻辑而不必重新访问外部网站
可以跳过所有 URL 去重
可以让每个域名每秒抓取无限次
可以避免对象存储
why: 原始 HTML 是昂贵网络抓取的结果；保存它后，抽取规则变化时只需重跑解析阶段。比如新增图片 alt 文本，不必重新抓整个网页。
why_en: Keeping raw HTML lets the team rerun extraction logic for new requirements without repeating the expensive external fetch.
options_en: You can swap the text-extraction logic without re-fetching the page from the web.
You can skip all URL deduplication.
You can crawl a domain unlimited times per second.
You can avoid using object storage.
q_en: What direct benefit does keeping raw HTML give when extraction requirements change later?

q: 抓取失败后只在 Worker 内存里 sleep 几秒再试，主要问题是什么？
options: 会让 S3 存储账单明显变贵
Worker 崩溃会丢失重试计时，短暂重试往往也没用
会强制所有抓取请求变成同步执行
会导致 robots.txt 完全无法下载
why: 内存定时器不持久，Worker 掉线后重试计划消失。抓取失败常常需要指数退避，而不是盲等几秒。
why_en: An in-memory retry timer is not durable, so a worker crash loses the retry plan and a short fixed delay is usually too naive.
options_en: It would make S3 storage noticeably more expensive.
A worker crash loses the retry timer, and a short fixed delay rarely helps anyway.
It would force every fetch request to become synchronous.
It would prevent robots.txt from ever being downloaded.
q_en: What is the main problem with sleeping in worker memory before retrying a failed fetch?

q: Kafka 自建重试相比 SQS 可见性超时方案的主要劣势是？
options: Kafka 完全无法记录消费 offset
Kafka 不能保留任何消息日志
Kafka 要自建失败 topic 和调度服务才能退避
Kafka 不支持多个消费者同时读取
why: Kafka 可以做，但要自己维护失败 topic、调度服务和下一次重试时间。SQS 直接给了 visibility timeout、ChangeMessageVisibility 和 DLQ 这些更贴合的原语。
why_en: Kafka can support retries with custom topics and services, but SQS provides simpler primitives for delayed retries and dead-letter handling.
scenario: 团队正在比较用 Kafka 还是 SQS 承载抓取重试，重点是失败后重新调度所需的额外基础设施。
tradeoff: SQS 内置可见性超时和 DLQ vs Kafka 需要自建重试基础设施
options_en: Kafka cannot track consumer offsets at all.
Kafka cannot retain any message log.
Kafka needs a custom failed-message topic and scheduler to implement backoff.
Kafka cannot support multiple consumers reading the same topic.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分布式消息日志系统，消费者通过 offset 追踪已处理到的位置。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Kafka is a distributed log where consumers track their position with an offset.

termDefinitions.meaning: AWS 托管消息队列，通过可见性超时和显式删除管理消息生命周期。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SQS is AWS's managed queue that manages message lifecycle with visibility timeouts and explicit deletes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 死信队列，用来存放重试多次仍失败的消息。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dead-letter queue holds messages that have failed processing after repeated retries.

optionMeanings: 错：offset 由消费者自行维护追踪
错：Kafka 靠日志天然支持长期保留
对：这正是自建退避的额外成本
错：Kafka 支持多消费者组并行读
q_en: What is the main downside of building crawler retries on Kafka compared with SQS visibility timeouts?
scenario_en: The team is comparing Kafka and SQS for crawler retries, focusing on how much extra infrastructure is needed to reschedule failed fetches.

scenario: URL 抓取失败后希望指数退避，消息不要被其他 Worker 立刻拿走；同时不能无限重试，失败多次后要隔离出来分析。
q: 最合适的队列机制组合是？
options: Redis list，Worker 进程内 sleep 重试
Kafka 单 topic，不记录失败次数
把重试计划写进本地 cron 文件
SQS：ChangeMessageVisibility + DLQ 组合
why: SQS 可以按接收次数动态延长可见性超时来实现退避，超过 maxReceiveCount 后进入 DLQ。这样重试状态由队列服务持久管理。
why_en: SQS can implement backoff by changing message visibility based on receive count and move exhausted messages to a DLQ.
whenOtherWins: 如果团队已有 Kafka 平台且能接受自建 retry scheduler，Kafka 也能做；如果任务非常小，本地重试可能足够。
diagram:
flowchart LR
Queue[SQS queue] --> Worker[Fetcher]
Worker -->|success delete| Done[Done]
Worker -->|fail no delete| Retry[Visibility timeout]
Retry --> Queue
Worker -->|too many| DLQ[Dead letter]
tradeoff: SQS 托管退避与死信 vs 自建队列机制
options_en: A Redis list with an in-process sleep for retries.
A single Kafka topic that does not track failure counts.
Write the retry schedule to a local cron file.
SQS: ChangeMessageVisibility plus a dead-letter queue.

termDefinitions.meaning: SQS 的 API，用来延长某条消息在队列里重新可见前的隐藏时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ChangeMessageVisibility is the SQS API that extends how long a message stays hidden before becoming visible again.

termDefinitions.meaning: 消息被接收次数超过阈值后自动转入的死信队列。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dead-letter queue automatically receives a message once it has been received too many times.

optionMeanings: 错：单机内存重试，Worker 崩溃即丢
错：没有失败计数，无法退避判断
错：本地文件不具备跨实例可见性
对：这正是 SQS 的托管重试原语组合
q_en: Which queue mechanism combination best fits this retry requirement?
scenario_en: After a URL fetch fails, the crawler needs exponential backoff so other workers do not grab it immediately, plus a limit that isolates repeatedly failing messages.

q: 这个 SQS 重试上限设计的核心用意是什么？
options: 允许对暂时性故障重试，同时避免对长期失败站点无限重试
确保每个 URL 最终都会被成功抓取一次
让爬虫可以完全跳过 robots.txt 检查
把失败消息永久留在原队列里反复处理
why: 重试上限加 DLQ 把「暂时故障」和「该放弃」分开，既不会无限重试拖垮吞吐，也不会无声丢弃失败 URL。
why_en: A capped retry count paired with a DLQ separates transient failures from sites that are truly unreachable, without silently dropping work or retrying forever.
scenario: SQS 的 redrive policy 配置了 maxReceiveCount；示例策略是消息被接收 5 次仍失败后，自动移入死信队列（DLQ）。
options_en: It retries transient failures while avoiding endless retries on dead sites.
It guarantees every URL is eventually fetched successfully.
It lets the crawler skip robots.txt checks entirely.
It keeps failed messages in the original queue forever.

termDefinitions.meaning: 死信队列，存放重试多次仍失败的消息，供后续排查。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dead-letter queue holds messages that failed processing after the retry limit is reached.

q_en: What is the main purpose of this SQS retry cap?
scenario_en: The SQS redrive policy sets maxReceiveCount; in this example, a message moves to the dead-letter queue after five failed receives.

q: SQS 中 Worker 抓取 URL 时崩溃但还没 delete message，会发生什么？
options: 消息会永久丢失
消息在超时后重新可见，其他 Worker 能接手处理
队列会自动把 HTML 写进 S3
所有后续消息都会停止投递
why: SQS 的消息只有显式删除才算完成；Worker 崩溃时消息会在超时后重新出现。这样半处理的 URL 不会因为 Worker 死亡而丢失。
why_en: If the worker dies before deleting the SQS message, it becomes visible again after the timeout and another worker can retry it.
options_en: The message is lost permanently.
The message becomes visible again after the timeout, and another worker can pick it up.

You should drop self-managed caching and rely on a single third-party provider.
At crawler scale, DNS is a real bottleneck that needs caching and multiple providers.
DNS lookup time can be ignored entirely with no optimization.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把域名解析成 IP 地址的系统。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DNS resolves a domain name into an IP address.

q_en: What does a high DNS time share imply for web crawler design?
scenario_en: Early crawler research, such as the Mercator paper, found that before custom resolver optimizations, DNS lookups could take about 70% of each thread's time.

scenario: 爬虫会反复抓取同一域名下的多个 URL，DNS 解析在高并发下成为瓶颈。
q: 第一层 DNS 优化是什么？
options: 每次请求都强制绕过缓存
把 DNS 查询写入 S3
用 Bloom Filter 代替 DNS
在 Crawler 中缓存域名到 IP 的解析结果
why: 同一域名的多个 URL 可以复用 DNS 结果，减少网络往返和外部 DNS 压力。缓存需要尊重 TTL，但它是最直接的优化。
why_en: Caching DNS results lets many URLs on the same domain reuse one lookup and reduces external resolver load.
whenOtherWins: 如果域名解析高度动态或 TTL 极短，缓存时间要更保守；如果单一 provider 达到限额，还要叠加多 provider。
tradeoff: 缓存复用解析结果 vs 每次都发起新查询
options_en: Force every request to bypass the cache.
Write DNS query logs into S3.
Replace DNS lookups with a Bloom filter.
Cache the domain-to-IP resolution inside the crawler.

termDefinitions.meaning: DNS 记录的缓存有效期，过期后需要重新解析。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL is how long a DNS record stays valid in cache before it must be re-resolved.

optionMeanings: 错：绕开缓存等于放弃优化
错：S3 不能替代域名解析
错：Bloom Filter 不做域名解析
对：复用解析结果减少往返
q_en: What is the first DNS optimization layer?
scenario_en: The crawler repeatedly fetches multiple URLs from the same domain, and DNS resolution becomes a bottleneck at high concurrency.

scenario: 第三方 DNS provider 有 QPS 限制，单 provider 很容易在全网抓取时触顶；团队希望快速降低被限流风险。
q: 第三方 DNS 限流下的务实优化是什么？
options: 多个 DNS provider 轮询分摊请求
停止 DNS 解析，直接猜 IP
把所有域名固定到同一个 IP
只抓取没有域名的 URL
why: 多 DNS provider 轮询能分散负载，降低单点限流风险。它不学术但很实用，适合在面试里展示真实约束意识。
why_en: Round-robining across multiple DNS providers spreads resolver load and reduces the chance of hitting one provider's rate limits.
whenOtherWins: 如果团队能运营自建高性能 resolver，自建也可能更优；若流量很小，单 provider 加缓存就足够。
tradeoff: 多 provider 分摊限流风险 vs 单一 provider 简单但脆弱
options_en: Round-robin across multiple DNS providers.
Stop resolving DNS and guess the IP directly.
Pin every domain to the same IP address.
Only crawl URLs that have no domain name.
q_en: What practical optimization helps when a third-party DNS provider rate-limits you?
scenario_en: Third-party DNS providers have QPS limits, and one provider can hit its cap during web-scale crawling, so the team wants a quick way to reduce throttling risk.

q: 补全 URL 级去重和内容级去重的区别：
text: {{URL 级去重}} 在入队前查 Metadata DB，避免同一 URL 重复抓；{{内容级去重}} 在抓取后对页面内容哈希，识别不同 URL 返回相同内容。
why: URL 去重便宜但不够，因为不同 URL 可能返回同一页面。内容哈希去重能跳过重复内容的解析和存储。
why_en: URL deduplication avoids repeated URLs before enqueueing, while content deduplication hashes fetched pages to catch identical content served by different URLs.
q_en: Fill in the difference between URL-level and content-level deduplication:

scenario: 抓取后需要判断 HTML 内容是否已经见过，希望准确、不引入误判，并且 Metadata DB 能承受索引写入。
q: 这个爬虫更偏向的实用内容去重方案是？
options: 完全跳过内容去重这一步
hash 存入 Metadata DB 并建索引
只比较 URL 字符串是否相同
只用进程内存 Set，不落盘
why: 内容 hash 加索引简单、准确，现代数据库维护大索引通常可接受。这个方案比 Bloom Filter 更适合追求准确和简单的主线设计。
why_en: Storing content hashes in the metadata database with an index is simple, exact, and practical for deduplicating fetched pages.
whenOtherWins: 如果内存和查询延迟极端敏感且能接受少量漏抓，Bloom Filter 可以更省空间；只做 URL 去重会漏掉重复内容。
tradeoff: 简单准确的 hash 索引 vs 省内存但有误判的 Bloom Filter
options_en: Skip content deduplication entirely.
Store the content hash in the metadata DB and index that column.
Only compare URL strings.
Use an in-memory set with no persistence.
q_en: Which practical content-deduplication approach fits this crawler best?
scenario_en: After fetching a page, the crawler must tell whether the HTML content has been seen before; it wants exact results and the Metadata DB can handle indexed writes.

q: Bloom Filter 在内容去重里的核心语义是什么？
options: 它能返回原始 HTML
它能替代所有数据库索引且没有误差
说不存在时一定不存在，说存在时只是可能存在
说存在时一定存在，说不存在时只是可能不存在
why: Bloom Filter 没有 false negative，但有 false positive。用于去重时，可能把没抓过的内容误判为已抓过。
why_en: A Bloom filter can prove an item is absent but only says it is probably present, so false positives are the main trade-off.
scenario: 系统要在抓取后判断内容是否已抓过；对比 Bloom Filter 和精确 hash 索引在「是否存在」判断上的语义差异。
tradeoff: 精确但重的 hash 索引 vs 省内存但有 false positive 的 Bloom Filter
options_en: It can return the original HTML content.
It can replace every database index with zero error.
Saying 'absent' is always certain; saying 'present' is only probable.
Saying 'present' is always certain; saying 'absent' is only probable.

termDefinitions.meaning: 概率型集合结构：不存在时一定准确，存在时可能是假阳性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Bloom filter is a probabilistic set: a negative answer is certain, but a positive answer can be a false positive.

termDefinitions.meaning: 误判为存在，实际上并不存在。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A false positive means the filter says an item is present when it actually is not.

q_en: What is the core Bloom filter semantic in content deduplication?
scenario_en: The crawler must decide after fetching whether content has been seen before, so compare Bloom filters and exact hash indexes on existence-check semantics.

q: 在爬虫内容去重中使用 Bloom Filter 的主要风险是什么？
options: 一定会重复抓取所有页面
会让对象存储失去持久性
会禁止 URL 深度字段
误判某个新页面已经抓过，从而跳过它
why: false positive 会让系统误以为某个内容 hash 已存在，导致少量新页面被跳过。可以增大 filter 和 hash 函数数量来降低概率，但不能完全消除。
why_en: The risk is a false positive that causes the crawler to skip a page it has not actually processed.
scenario: 系统已经决定用 Bloom Filter 做内容去重，用来快速跳过可能重复的页面。
options_en: It will definitely re-crawl every single page.
It strips durability from object storage.
It forbids using a URL depth field.
It may mistakenly treat an unseen page as already crawled and skip it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 概率型集合结构，可能有假阳性但没有假阴性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Bloom filter is a probabilistic set that can produce false positives but never false negatives.

termDefinitions.meaning: 误判为已存在，实际是新内容。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A false positive here means new content is wrongly treated as already seen.

q_en: What is the main risk of using a Bloom filter for crawler content deduplication?
scenario_en: The crawler has chosen a Bloom filter for content deduplication so it can quickly skip pages that appear to be duplicates.

scenario: 面试官问 Bloom Filter 是否应该用于本题内容去重；系统追求简单准确，现代数据库索引成本可接受。
q: 内容去重里是否应该优先使用 Bloom Filter？
options: 先用 hash 索引；Bloom Filter 留作可选优化
完全不需要任何去重
只靠 URL 字符串比较就够了
坚持用 Bloom Filter，因为它永远不会误判
why: Bloom Filter 有趣但对这条主线偏过度设计；hash 索引更简单且准确。能说明何时 Bloom Filter 胜出，比机械套数据结构更高级。
why_en: The practical answer is to use an indexed content hash first and treat a Bloom filter as an optional optimization with false-positive cost.
whenOtherWins: 当 hash 集合极大、内存/查询压力极高、业务能接受少量漏抓时，Bloom Filter 才更有吸引力。
diagram:
flowchart LR
HTML[Raw HTML] --> Extract[Extract text]
Extract --> Hash[Content fingerprint]
Hash --> Seen[(Seen index)]
Seen --> Store[Store if new]
tradeoff: 简单准确优先 vs 省内存但要接受 false positive
options_en: Start with a hash index; keep the Bloom filter as an optional later optimization.
Skip deduplication entirely.
Rely only on comparing URL strings.
Insist on a Bloom filter because it never makes mistakes.
optionMeanings: 对：先用精确集合挡重复，之后再加概率过滤层
错：会导致大量重复内容入库
错：不同 URL 可能返回同一内容
错：概率结构仍可能把新内容当旧内容
q_en: Should a Bloom filter be the first choice for content deduplication here?
scenario_en: The interviewer asks whether a Bloom filter should be used for content deduplication; the system prefers simple exact behavior and can afford a database index.

q: Crawler trap 指的是什么？
options: 队列里的死信消息
让爬虫在同一站点无限跟链接、难以结束的页面结构
DNS provider 的免费额度
S3 的对象版本控制
why: Crawler trap 可能通过自链接、日历页、无限参数等方式制造无限链接空间。爬虫如果没有边界，会把时间耗在局部站点上。
why_en: A crawler trap is a link structure that keeps the crawler following effectively endless pages within the same site.
options_en: A dead-letter message sitting in a queue.
A link structure that keeps the crawler following endless links on one site.
A DNS provider's free-tier quota.
S3 object versioning.
q_en: What is a crawler trap?

q: 防止 crawler trap 的简单措施是什么？
options: 直接禁用所有 DNS 缓存机制
永远优先抓取最深的链接
记录 link-hop depth，超阈值停止扩展
把所有 URL 强行改成同一个域名
why: depth 是从种子 URL 起算的链接跳数，不是路径段数。超过 15-20 这类阈值时停止扩展，可以避免在无限站点结构里耗尽时间。
why_en: Tracking link-hop depth from the seed URL and cutting off branches beyond a threshold prevents crawler traps from consuming the crawl.
options_en: Disable all DNS caching.
Always prioritize the deepest links first.
Record link-hop depth and stop expanding a branch past a threshold.
Rewrite every URL to the same domain.
q_en: What is a simple way to avoid crawler traps?

scenario: 需求后来要求抓取 React/Angular 页面中由 JavaScript 加载出来的正文，而静态 HTML 里没有这些内容。
q: 抓取 JavaScript 动态内容需要引入什么能力？
options: 只增加 SQS 可见性超时
只提高 DNS 查询的 QPS
用 Bloom Filter 代替浏览器渲染
用 headless browser 渲染后再抽取正文
why: 动态内容需要执行 JavaScript 并等待页面渲染，普通 HTTP 抓 HTML 不够。Headless browser 能解决，但成本和复杂度明显更高。
why_en: JavaScript-rendered pages require a headless browser to execute scripts and extract the rendered content.
whenOtherWins: 如果页面正文已经在服务端 HTML 中，普通 fetch 更便宜、更快；动态渲染处理在本题主范围外。
tradeoff: 渲染后抽取覆盖 JS 内容 vs 普通 HTTP 抓取更便宜更快
options_en: Just increase the SQS visibility timeout.
Just raise the DNS query rate limit.
Replace browser rendering with a Bloom filter.
Render with a headless browser like Puppeteer or Playwright, then extract.

termDefinitions.meaning: 没有图形界面、可编程控制的浏览器，能执行 JavaScript 渲染页面。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A headless browser is a scriptable browser without a GUI that can execute JavaScript to render a page.

optionMeanings: 错：可见性超时和渲染能力无关
错：DNS 速度不影响页面渲染
错：Bloom Filter 不能渲染页面
对：只有渲染后才能拿到 JS 内容
q_en: What capability is needed to crawl JavaScript-rendered content?
scenario_en: The requirement expands to text loaded by JavaScript in React or Angular pages, and that text is missing from the static HTML.

scenario: 有些 URL 指向非常大的文件，系统只想抓取适合文本抽取的页面，避免下载超过 10MB 的对象。
q: 抓取前更合适的优化是什么？
options: 先用 HEAD 探测 Content-Length
直接 GET 下载完整文件再决定
把整个文件塞进队列消息体
直接关闭所有失败重试机制
why: HEAD 可以用很小的代价读取 Content-Length 等元数据，提前跳过大文件。这样节省带宽和 Worker 时间。
why_en: An HTTP HEAD request can check Content-Length cheaply so oversized files are skipped before downloading the body.
whenOtherWins: 如果服务端不支持 HEAD 或 Content-Length 不可信，可能需要带 Range 的探测或下载后中止策略。
tradeoff: 先探测大小再决定 vs 先下载再判断
options_en: Send a HEAD request to probe Content-Length before deciding.
GET the entire file first and decide afterward.
Stuff the file into the queue message body.
Turn off all retries.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只请求响应头、不下载响应体的 HTTP 方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HEAD is an HTTP method that fetches only the response headers, not the body.

termDefinitions.meaning: HTTP 响应头，声明响应体的字节大小。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Content-Length is a response header that declares the size of the response body in bytes.

q_en: What is the better pre-fetch optimization?
scenario_en: Some URLs point to very large files, and the crawler only wants pages suitable for text extraction, avoiding objects larger than 10 MB.

scenario: 需求从一次性抓取变成每月重新抓取，且不同 URL 应按最近抓取时间、重要性或变化频率安排下次抓取。
q: 持续重新抓取时应该新增哪个组件？
options: 单机本地队列
URL Scheduler
更大的 robots.txt 文件
只读 DNS 缓存
why: URL Scheduler 根据 last crawl time、优先级或 popularity 决定何时把 URL 放回队列。持续更新和一次性 crawl 的调度问题不同。
why_en: A URL scheduler decides when to re-enqueue pages based on recency, priority, or popularity for continual crawling.
whenOtherWins: 如果需求只是一次性离线抓取，解析 Worker 直接把新 URL 入队即可，不必单独引入调度器。
diagram:
flowchart TD
URL[Candidate URL] --> Rules[Trap heuristics]
Rules --> Depth[Depth and pattern caps]
Rules --> Score[Quality score]
Score --> Frontier[Priority frontier]
tradeoff: 按时间/优先级调度重新抓取 vs 一次性抓取无需调度
options_en: A single-machine local queue.
A URL Scheduler.
A bigger robots.txt file.
A read-only DNS cache.

termDefinitions.meaning: 根据上次抓取时间、优先级或热度决定何时重新入队的组件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A URL scheduler decides when to re-enqueue a page based on recency, priority, or popularity.

q_en: What component should be added for ongoing recrawls?
scenario_en: The requirement changes from a one-time crawl to a monthly recrawl, and different URLs should be scheduled by last crawl time, importance, or change frequency.

scenario: 业务希望优先抓取重要域名或热门页面，但队列系统本身不提供单队列内的严格优先级消费。
q: 队列不支持严格优先级时，一个简单可解释的方案是什么？
options: 只在 Metadata DB 改字段，不改消费逻辑
禁用死信队列
多个优先级队列，Worker 先轮询高优先级
把所有 URL 随机打散
why: 多个队列或 Kafka 多 topic 可以模拟优先级，Worker 先消费高优先级再降级消费普通队列。这样不必在单队列里实现复杂排序。
why_en: Separate queues or topics per priority let crawlers poll high-priority work first without requiring sorted consumption inside one queue.
whenOtherWins: 如果队列产品原生支持优先级，可直接使用；如果所有 URL 价值接近，单队列更简单。
tradeoff: 多队列模拟优先级 vs 单队列里排序
options_en: Only change a field in the Metadata DB without changing consumption logic.
Disable the dead-letter queue.
Multiple priority queues, with workers polling the high-priority one first.
Shuffle all URLs randomly.
q_en: What simple priority scheme works when the queue lacks strict priority support?
scenario_en: The business wants to crawl important domains or popular pages first, but the queue does not support strict priority inside one queue.

q: 把「可恢复且礼貌的爬虫」核心决策链排成正确顺序。
steps: 用 SQS visibility timeout、ChangeMessageVisibility 和 DLQ 管理重试与失败隔离
在 Metadata DB 中保存 URL/Domain 状态和对象存储引用
先承认单体 Crawler 任一步失败都会让进度难以恢复
用 robots 规则、每域名锁和共享限流保证礼貌抓取
把抓取与解析拆成流水线阶段，队列消息只传记录 id
why: 先识别单体失败面，再拆流水线并持久化状态；有了队列语义后才能可靠重试，最后叠加 robots 和限流保证对外部站点友好。
why_en: The robust design starts by isolating pipeline stages, persists metadata, uses SQS retry semantics, and then layers in robots-aware politeness controls.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A[Single crawler failure risk] --> B[Pipeline stages]
  B --> C[Metadata DB references]
  C --> D[SQS retry and DLQ]
  D --> E[Robots and rate limits]
q_en: Put the core decision chain for a recoverable and polite crawler in the correct order.
